## Key Capabilities & Products
1. **Duplex Boxes / Mono-Cartons (HSN Code 48192020)**
   - Specializes in medical, orthopedic, and retail folding paperboard boxes.
   - Products include: Wrist Binder Boxes, Knee Cap Packaging, Cervical Collar Boxes, Lumbar Support Cartons, Orthopedic Traction Kit Boxes.
   - Board Types: 300–450 GSM White Duplex Board, Cyber XL Board, Folding Box Board (FBB).
   - Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ): 2,500 pieces.

2. **Corrugated Packaging Boxes**
   - 3-Ply single-wall corrugated boxes for transit and retail packaging.
   - 5-Ply double-wall heavy-duty master cartons (18 to 32 Bursting Factor) for bulk transport.
   - Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ): 500 pieces.

3. **In-House Quality Offset Printing & Value-Add Finishes**
   - Sheetfed multi-color CMYK and Pantone commercial offset printing up to 28 x 40 inches.
   - Thermal BOPP Lamination: Matte, Gloss, and Velvet Soft-Touch finishes.
   - Spot UV gloss coating and drip-off textured varnish.
   - Hot foil stamping: Gold, Silver, Rose Gold, and Holographic foils.
   - 3D Embossing, Debossing, and compliant Braille printing.
   - Automatic die-cutting, creasing, and folder-gluing.
